provenance.asset_description: Requiem Dragon Concept, artist Kent Hamilton: A sketch design of a requiem dragon, a dragon with webbing between its legs and a pair of horns growing upward and downward on the front of its face. The sketch includes a close-up look of the dragon’s features.
